subject: sky.records

recordTypes.summary: One governed Sky-ecosystem term whose definition is reused across organizational records and policy projections.

fields.summary: The governed abbreviation when one exists.
The portable organizational definition of the term.
The stable Sky subject area that owns use of the term.
Exact public source references that ground the current definition.

content.summary: Sky term records contain definition and grounding facts only.

limitations: This model defines portable vocabulary shape; the governed context.sky vocabulary artifact owns the exact current term set and definitions.
A term definition grants no governance interpretation, onchain action, provider write, or execution authority.
